extra_quotes: For the numerical calculations, we employ a scaled tight-binding Hamiltonian for graphene [2, 44].

The antidot density scale set by the patterned periodic potential is more than an order of magnitude smaller than the residual carrier density. Consequently, the superlattice-induced satellite Dirac points cannot be resolved and remain hidden beneath the primary Dirac peak.
